== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Fire Extinguisher]] and [[Fire Extinguisher (PC Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · PC Errata (Appendix A). Glossary 2.0 intermediate has no (Errata) article. Same-words 2018 E Holotable remaster is folded into PC Errata, not a column. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata · PC Errata (omit missing). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
